breaking_news.headline: Poll: Most Americans have the summer blues about Trump and the economy
breaking_news.summary: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds a record low share of Americans approve of President Trump's job performance and his handling of the economy heading into the summer before a key midterm election.

breaking_news.headline: Here is how SpaceX could turn up in your current investments
breaking_news.summary: SpaceX stock hit the market last week. Here's how it could turn up in your retirement or investment portfolio.

breaking_news.headline: Alan Greenspan, the legendary former Federal Reserve chair, dies
breaking_news.summary: During his chairmanship, Greenspan was celebrated as possibly the best central banker in history. But later, his reputation was tarnished by the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.

breaking_news.headline: Did you know? Alan Greenspan and Ayn Rand were close friends
breaking_news.summary: One of the most intellectually important relationships in the life of the late Fed chair Alan Greenspan was with his close friend, the formidable novelist and libertarian thinker Ayn Rand.

breaking_news.headline: When falling housing prices are good news — and when they're not
breaking_news.summary: Denver renters are celebrating falling housing costs. But sometimes cheaper housing is a sign of economic decline. How can you tell the difference?

breaking_news.headline: Is AI 'one big bubble'? Behind the tech sell-off
breaking_news.summary: Investors are selling off AI-related stocks as doubts are starting to surface over whether the massive spending on AI is worth the investment and whether it's "one big bubble."

breaking_news.headline: Congress passes the largest housing affordability bill in decades — and Trump cancels the signing
breaking_news.summary: President Trump canceled a signing ceremony for the bill Wednesday, saying Congress must first pass a strict voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: Canada eligible to join Eurovision competition
breaking_news.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney raised the idea of Canada joining the song contest in his 2025 budget.

breaking_news.headline: Four men held over child-marriage in Sierra Leone set to appear in landmark court case
breaking_news.summary: It relates to a 17-year-old girl - four men including her father and husband face years in jail if convicted.

breaking_news.headline: Reflecting Pool liner cut with sharp knife or razor, National Park Service says
breaking_news.summary: Earlier in the week Donald Trump blamed vandals for "a 300 foot long gash" in the pool and accused someone of putting fertiliser in the water.

breaking_news.headline: Senior Ukrainian intelligence official jailed for life for spying for Russia
breaking_news.summary: Col Dmytro Kozyura agreed to share state secrets and systematically disclosed classified information, prosecutors say.

breaking_news.headline: Christmas market attacker jailed for life for murdering six in Germany
breaking_news.summary: A nine-year-old and five women were killed when Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen drove into the market in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
breaking_news.summary: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

breaking_news.headline: Aerial footage reveals destruction in coastal Venezuela
breaking_news.summary: Multi-storey buildings have collapsed in La Guaira following two major earthquakes on Wednesday.

breaking_news.headline: Earthquake is devastating blow to Venezuela at time of uncertainty
breaking_news.summary: The twin quakes come less than six months after Venezuela's then-leader Nicolás Maduro was seized by US forces.

breaking_news.headline: Apple hikes some prices by nearly 20% while Xbox raises console cost
breaking_news.summary: Apple said it had "never seen a component price increase this much, this quickly".

breaking_news.headline: Teens who hacked TfL were known to police years before cyber-attack
breaking_news.summary: Owen Flowers and Thalha Jubair were convicted for their roles in the attack, which led to large costs for Transport for London.

breaking_news.headline: The abundant but expensive energy source that's under your feet
breaking_news.summary: Start-ups are taking fresh approaches to geothermal energy, but will the economics work?

breaking_news.headline: Who could be the UK's next chancellor?
breaking_news.summary: The prime minister's resignation has fired the starting gun on the race to be in charge of the UK's finances.
